title: Bespoke Beta Acceptance Matrix and GTM Checklist for Lighthouse Customers
creator: Ava Rodriguez
description: Create a tailored acceptance matrix and cross-functional GTM checklist for lighthouse/beta customers. Outcome: a single artifact that Program Managers, Solutions Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Eng can use to (1) decide when an account is 'beta-accepted', (2) coordinate release notes and customer messaging, and (3) operationalize feedback loops for quality regressions. Scope includes acceptance criteria per-account, instrumentation and dashboards to track success metrics, templated release notes and customer comms, and a launch-day runbook with rollback and escalation paths.
acceptance_criteria: Per-account acceptance matrix finalized and signed off by PM + SE + CS
Success metrics (latency, cost per request, error rate, feature usage) instrumented and visible on the beta dashboard
Release notes draft for lighthouse cohort approved by legal + marketing
Canary rollout plan + rollback runbook written and validated in staging
Feedback loop defined: weekly sync cadence, bug triage SLA, and CS->Eng priority queue established
tasks: Define acceptance thresholds for runtime SLOs (P50 latency, 95th, error rate) - Owner: Eng (refer ENG-4210) - Doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/beta/acceptance-matrix
Create per-account checklist (security review, data residency, API key provisioning, contract signatures) - Owner: Solutions Eng - Template: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1BetaTemplates
Draft customer-facing release notes & feature summary - Owner: Marketing - PR: https://github.com/redwood/marketing/pulls/178
Instrument dashboards: add tokens-per-session, cache-hit-rate, tail latency charts to beta dashboard - Owner: Observability - Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/beta/beta-dashboard
Prepare launch-day runbook (who calls customers, escalation matrix, rollback steps) - Owner: PM - Runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/runbooks/beta-launch
Set up feedback triage process (JIRA/Linear mapping, SLAs) and weekly sync calendar invite - Owner: Customer Success
Coordinate legal signoff on release messaging and usage terms - Owner: Legal
Schedule dry-run with Sales + SE + CS to rehearse launch communications - Owner: PM
risks: Model performance regressions during live beta could cause high customer churn if not caught early
Misaligned messaging between Marketing and Solutions Eng could lead to inaccurate expectations
Insufficient telemetry for early detection of cost regressions (spike in tokens per session)
Onboarding delays due to incomplete security paperwork for regulated customers
